checks.name: Frontend loads and SPACEVOICE controls render in persistent profile + isolated context
Real join/presence, deterministic single offer, targeted offer/answer, bidirectional ICE, connected RTC, ontrack and inbound RTP bytes
Mute changes local audio track; deafen changes only local remote playback
Leave closes RTC, stops capture, detaches WS handlers, removes remote audio and peer on both clients
Reentry without reload has one active peer/audio/socket per client
Real WebSocket drop triggers peer cleanup and automatic reconnect/new join/new RTC
Different rooms via public session API remain isolated across browser contexts
BroadcastChannel local transport connects same-profile tabs with real RTC and no WS
BroadcastChannel remains partitioned: persistent profile and isolated context do not discover each other
